info.title: dw-agent HTTP API
info.description: HTTP resource operations under /api; authenticated replayable event subscriptions at /dw-agent/v1. Generated from scripts/export-openapi.ts. No legacy business commands or aliases.

put.description: Untrusted scene data, at most 32 KiB and 100 objects. Object IDs must appear in allowed_object_ids. Expiry is bounded to five minutes. This is not persistent memory or executable instruction.

post.description: The segment must belong to this session. started precedes completed/interrupted/failed. An identical report is idempotent; a terminal state cannot be changed.

patch.description: expected_revision is null for a new custom provider and the catalog revision for an update. Credentials are literal write-only strings, never returned.
Path id is the percent-encoded provider model name, not the catalog resource ID. expected_revision is null on creation.

202.description: Accepted; execution continues independently of this connection

get.description: Bootstrap principal.id === root only. Managed tokens cannot enumerate or delegate tokens, even with manage permission.

post.description: Bootstrap principal.id === root only. The plaintext token is returned once, never persisted for response replay. Repeating the same key cannot reveal it again.

delete.description: Bootstrap principal.id === root only; manage permission on a managed token is insufficient.

post.description: Reload installed allowlisted resources only when sessions are idle. Busy sessions return a conflict; no implicit cancellation or package installation.

bearerAuth.description: Root bootstrap token or managed scoped token. Never put a token in a URL.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Persist and replay the exact original key, method, path, query and body. Keys are principal-scoped; a changed request conflicts. An interrupted durable intent must not be re-executed with a new key.

ExpectedRevision.name: expected_revision
ExpectedRevision.description: Current resource revision; refresh on conflict, do not overwrite blindly.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque query-scoped cursor from next_cursor; never interpret as an offset or event seq.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method is not supported for this resource; see Allow header

CursorExpired.description: The cursor can no longer be replayed

TooLarge.description: Request exceeds byte or object limits

Capabilities.description: Configured runtime capabilities. Feature flags reflect actual support and availability; a workspace is not an OS sandbox.

ToolCallData.description: Structured tool state; not a provider private-reasoning stream.

token.description: Shown only once. A repeated request cannot recover the plaintext token.

x-websocket.delivery: At least once; deduplicate by stream_id and seq, replay from the last contiguous per-stream cursor.
x-websocket.resource_refresh: Run/task/approval notifications are bounded references and status, not full resources. GET the referenced run/task/approval or session messages when details are needed. Approval arguments and hashes are available by authorized GET only. reply.segment is the authoritative streamed presentation payload.
